title: SellFinder Dataset Schema
description: Contract for historical listing data delivered by /data-pipeline to /model for training. One record = one closed or still-open marketplace listing. The item-facing fields (item_id, category, price, condition, brand, days_listed, attributes) intentionally mirror PredictionItem in prediction_api.json so training and inference share one feature space; sold/days_to_sell/final_sale_price are the historical outcome labels used only for training.

days_listed.description: Number of days the item had been listed as of this record, if known.

attributes.description: Free-form extra features, passed through from the source listing.

sold.description: Whether the listing eventually sold. Training label for sell_probability.

days_to_sell.description: Days between listing and sale. Null when sold is false. Training label for estimated_days_to_sell.

final_sale_price.description: Actual sale price. Null when sold is false. Training label for recommended_price.
